pr_body:
### workload/schemachange: limit amount of params generated by create fn
Previously, our schemachange workload flaked due to some `CREATE
FUNCTION`s 
randomly generated with >= 100 params; however, this is not
allowed and not a particularly useful edge case to test. This patch
prevents these types of functions from being generated by adding a
restriction to the max length of fn params.

Informs: #116649

Epic: none
Release note: None

---

### workload/schemachange: handle cases of duplicate functions
This patch ensures that our schemachange workload is able
to handle cases where we could generate duplicate functions
(same name, same param types). We will now detect whether
or not a duplicate function has been generated and add the
proper error to our expected errors list.

Fixes: #117421

Epic: none
Release note: None

issue_context.title: workload/schemachange: consider if function already exists when creating
issue_context.body:
Successive calls to `schemachange` workload may decide to create a function with the same name. If that happens, the second call could get an error of the form `function \"udf_24\" already exists with same argument types`.

Instead, the `schemachange` workload could check if the function already exists and avoid this error. 

Jira issue: CRDB-35167
comments:
Interesting - it does look like we do try to keep the function names unique in order to not encounter this: https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/blob/ecb7bf553ccd3029d78468aad7b5086e255a6c72/pkg/workload/schemachange/operation_generator.go#L3917

but looking at the failures, udf_24 was indeed created before this 

```
"sql": "CREATE FUNCTION udf_24()\n\tRETURNS VOID\n\tLANGUAGE SQL\n\tAS $$ SELECT NULL WHERE TRUE $$"
```
created before
```
"sql": "CREATE FUNCTION udf_24()\n\tRETURNS VOID\n\tLANGUAGE SQL\n\tAS $$ SELECT NULL $$"
```

I'll need to understand more about what is going on; however, I have a hunch that this comment might be the reason:
https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/blob/6f56f0cb849d1389820128cadb813113272481cc/pkg/workload/schemachange/schemachange.go#L300-L305

used here in the schemachange workload:

https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/blob/6f56f0cb849d1389820128cadb813113272481cc/pkg/workload/schemachange/schemachange.go#L252
Yes I think that is the reason for this. The way to resolve it would be to detect if the function exists already and if so, expect this error.

review_comments: 👋 i can also add `fold` (i think also known as `reduce`) to this utils pkg as well & use that here instead of mapping, but figured i would suggest it first before doing (i promise it would be quick)
My 2c: I think the `map` implementation is fine. With `fold`, the closure would have to manage the formatting inline, and it's nice to rely on `strings.Join` for that.
